buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Procurement and Supply of Soil for Earth Filling Works through GeM The following Additional Terms and Conditions shall be applicable to all bidders participating in the GeM bi dding process for the supply of soil required for earth filling works at the designated delivery location. 1. Scope of Work The successful bidder shall arrange, procure, excavate (wherever applicable), load, transport and unload s uitable soil at the designated delivery location as specified by the Buyer. The supply shall include all costs towards loading, transportation, unloading, labour, machinery, handling, taxes and other incidental expen ses required for complete delivery. 2. Quality and Specifications of Soil 1. 1. The soil supplied shall be clean, suitable and of good quality for earth filling and levelling purpose s. 2. 2. The soil shall be free from garbage, organic matter, vegetation, roots, tree stumps, plastic, constr uction debris, chemicals, hazardous substances and other unwanted materials. 3. 3. The soil shall not contain excessive clay, silt, peat or other unsuitable materials that may adverse ly affect compaction and stability. 4. 4. The soil shall be reasonably free from oversized stones, boulders and other materials unsuitable f or the intended earth filling work. 5. 5. The soil shall be suitable for spreading, levelling and compaction as per the requirements of the w ork.

6. 6. The Buyer reserves the right to get the quality of soil tested through an authorised laboratory, wh erever considered necessary. The cost of testing shall be borne by the bidder if the supplied material fails to meet the prescribed specifications. 3. Site Inspection Before Submission of Bid 1. 1. The bidder is advised to inspect the designated delivery location before submission of the bid to a ssess the site conditions, accessibility, approach roads, unloading arrangements and other logistical requirements. 2. 2. The bidder shall satisfy himself regarding the feasibility of transportation and unloading of soil at the specified location. 3. 3. No additional claim on account of difficult terrain, transportation constraints, distance, site conditi ons or accessibility shall be entertained after submission of the bid. 4. 4. The site inspection shall be at the bidder's own cost. 4. Source and Legality of Soil 1. 1. The successful bidder shall ensure that the soil is obtained from a lawful and authorised source or has obtained leagl earth cutting permission from the competent authority. 2. 2. The bidder shall be solely responsible for obtaining all applicable permissions, transit passes, roy alty receipts, mining permits or other statutory approvals required for extraction and transportation of soil. 3. 3. The bidder shall comply with all applicable rules and regulations of the Government concerning ex cavation, extraction and transportation of soil. 4. 4.No soil obtained through illegal excavation, unauthorised mining or from prohibited areas shall be accepted. 5. 5.The bidder shall submit copies of relevant permissions and supporting documents whenever dem anded by the Buyer. 5. Transportation and Delivery 1. 1.The successful bidder shall arrange adequate vehicles, machinery, manpower and other resources for timely supply of soil at the designated location. 2. 2.All transportation, loading, unloading and handling expenses shall be borne by the bidder. 3. 3.The bidder shall ensure that transportation vehicles comply with applicable traffic, environmental and safety regulations. 4. 4.The bidder shall take adequate precautions to prevent spillage of soil on public roads during trans portation. 5. 5.The bidder shall be responsible for any damage caused to public property, roads, infrastructure or government property during transportation and unloading. 6. 6.Delivery shall be made strictly at the location specified by the Buyer. 6. Quantity and Measurement 1. 1.The quantity of soil supplied shall be measured and verified by the authorised representative/tech nical officer of the Buyer at the designated delivery location. 2. 2. Measurement shall be carried out using an appropriate and mutually verifiable method, such as c alibrated weighment or measurement of the actual volume of soil delivered. 3. 3. The quantity recorded and certified by the authorised representative of the Buyer shall be final fo r the purpose of processing payment. 4. 4. Payment shall be restricted to the actual quantity received, measured and accepted by the Buyer , subject to the awarded contract quantity and value.

5. 5. No payment shall be admissible for excess, rejected or unverified quantities. 7. Inspection and Acceptance 1. 1. The Buyer or its authorised representative shall have the right to inspect the soil at the source, d uring transportation or upon delivery at the site. 2. 2.The supplied soil shall be subject to inspection and acceptance by the authorised representative o f the Buyer. 3. 3. The Buyer reserves the right to reject the entire or any part of the supplied material if it is found t o be unsuitable, contaminated, substandard or not in accordance with the prescribed specifications. 4. 4. Any rejected material shall be removed and replaced by the bidder at his own cost within the tim e stipulated by the Buyer. 5. 5. The decision of the competent authority/authorised technical representative regarding the suitabi lity and acceptance of the supplied material shall be binding for the purpose of contract execution. 8. Loading, Unloading and Spreading 1. 1.The bidder shall be responsible for safe loading and unloading of soil at the designated delivery lo cation. 2. 2. The bidder shall ensure that the unloading is carried out only at locations identified by the Buyer. 3. 3. The bidder shall not dump or stock soil at any unauthorised location. 4. 4. Any requirement for spreading, levelling and compaction shall be governed by the specific scope of work and BOQ mentioned in the GeM bid. Unless expressly included in the BOQ, these activities s hall not be presumed to be part of the supply contract. 9. Time Schedule for Supply 1. 1. The successful bidder shall complete the supply within the delivery period specified in the GeM bi d/work order. 2. 2. The bidder shall maintain adequate arrangements to ensure uninterrupted and timely supply. 3. 3. Any anticipated delay shall be immediately brought to the notice of the Buyer in writing, with rea sons. 4. 4. Delay in supply shall attract applicable liquidated damages and other contractual remedies as pe r GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC). 10. Price and Taxes 1. 1. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all costs towards procurement, loading, transportation, unlo ading, labour, machinery, statutory charges, royalty, applicable taxes and all other incidental expen ses. 2. 2. No additional payment shall be admissible on account of increase in transportation costs, fuel pri ces, labour charges or other incidental expenses during the contract period. 3. 3. The bidder shall ensure that the quoted rates cover delivery of soil at the exact location specified in the GeM bid. 11. Safety and Environmental Compliance 1. 1. The bidder shall ensure compliance with all applicable environmental, mining, transportation and labour safety regulations. 2. 2. The bidder shall be responsible for the safety of its personnel, vehicles and machinery during exe cution of the supply. 3. 3. The bidder shall take all necessary precautions to prevent damage to the surrounding environme nt, vegetation, drainage channels and public infrastructure.

4. 4. Any damage arising due to the negligence of the bidder shall be rectified at the bidder's own cost . 12. Payment Terms 1. 1. Payment shall be processed only after successful delivery, physical verification, measurement an d acceptance of the supplied soil by the authorised representative of the Buyer. 2. 2. No advance payment shall be admissible unless specifically provided in the GeM bid. 13. Non-Compliance and Contractual Action 1. 1. In case of supply of substandard soil, unauthorised sourcing, short supply, misrepresentation of q uantity or violation of contractual conditions, the Buyer shall be entitled to take appropriate action u nder the GeM GTC and applicable contractual provisions. 2. 2. Repeated failure to supply material as per specifications or delivery schedule may result in cance llation of the contract and other action permissible under GeM rules. 3. 3. The bidder shall indemnify the Buyer against losses, damages, penalties or legal liabilities arising out of the bidder's negligence, illegal sourcing or violation of applicable laws. 14. Acceptance of ATC Submission of the bid shall be deemed to constitute acceptance of all the above Additional Terms and Con ditions. Any deviation from the prescribed conditions shall be dealt with in accordance with the GeM bid co nditions and applicable GeM GTC. Note: All other terms and conditions of the GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), as amended from ti me to time, shall remain applicable and binding upon the successful bidder. .
